_doc: Format of ONE hook in facts.json. Part A: scripts/facts.py (eligibility only, never a ranking). Part B: the agent's decision after probing. Every eligible hook needs a Part B. The stop gate refuses the turn if a decision has no probe of the hook's probe_files.

B_agent.reason: why this hook fits (or does not fit) THIS seller now
B_agent.counter_evidence: facts that argue against this hook, and why they do not change the decision
